noreset_constants.basis: a constant hypothesis is kept only when the reset state (every reset port asserted for reset_cycles edges from an all-unknown power-up) gives that constant, or an acyclic reload is inductively constant from already established constants, or (self_hold, COORD 11-04) the register has no load path and one net forces the constant, listed per register with that net, which must be asserted before use; equality/FSM assumptions never establish a constant's base case
